description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §5.4, §5.7): the last ferrywoman of the Mere, at her landing on the Sunken Steps' lowest terrace. She tells of the five sunken bells of the drowned kings (quest.drowned_bells) and keeps the Stoneknuckles for the giant who rings them all; a Stoneblood giant hears more of the drowned kings' blood. Protected. M8 gate (F42): built from elder.tscn, the talkers' scene that carries the NpcTalker (villager.tscn has none: her dialogue could not be opened).
